title: Skills assessed
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to recognize words and phrases that indicate time, cause and effect, addition, and contrasting ideas.
Students will be able to analyze the use of pronouns and referencing to understand how information is connected in texts.
Students will be able to identify the purpose of various texts, determining if they are descriptive, narrative, informational, persuasive, discursive, or argumentative.
Students will be able to interpret words and phrases that suggest a writer's attitude or feelings
Students will be able to evaluate the difference between objective facts and subjective opinions within a given text.
Students will be able to deduce the meaning of an unfamiliar word or phrase by making inferences from the context.
Students will be able to apply skimming techniques to efficiently grasp the general idea of an entire text.
Students will be able to execute scanning techniques to effectively locate specific data, dates, or opinions.
